# Vincenzo's Plate

> > Authentic Italian cooking tutorials and traditional recipes from Chef Vincenzo, featuring classic dishes like Neapolitan Pizza, Spaghetti Carbonara, Tiramisu, and Bolognese Sauce.

Vincenzo's Plate is a culinary education platform dedicated to teaching authentic Italian cooking techniques and traditional recipes. Chef Vincenzo shares step-by-step tutorials for pasta dishes, desserts, appetizers, and complete Italian menus, emphasizing traditional methods and ingredients from various Italian regions including Sicily, Abruzzo, and Sorrento.

## Key Topics

- Italian Cooking
- Traditional Italian Recipes
- Pasta Recipes
- Spaghetti Carbonara
- Neapolitan Pizza
- Tiramisu
- Bolognese Sauce
- Panna Cotta
- Gnocchi
- Pecorino
- Homemade Pasta
- Italian Desserts
- Cooking Tutorials
- Authentic Italian Cuisine
- Regional Italian Dishes

## Essential Pasta Recipes

- [How to Make SPAGHETTI AGLIO E OLIO Like an Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/spaghetti-aglio-e-olio): Classic spaghetti with garlic, oil, and peperoncino recipe tutorial
- [How to Make TOMATO AND BASIL PASTA Like an Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/tomato-and-basil-pasta): Traditional vegetarian pasta al pomodoro with fresh basil recipe
- [How to Make SEMOLINA PASTA DOUGH Like an Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/semolina-pasta-dough): Homemade semolina pasta dough recipe with traditional techniques
- [How to Make CREAMY MUSHROOM PASTA Like an Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/creamy-mushroom-pasta): Vegetarian creamy mushroom pasta with fresh parsley recipe
- [How to make Spaghetti alla Carrettiera like an Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/spaghetti-alla-carrettiera): Ancient Sicilian spaghetti alla Carrettiera with simple ingredients

## Classic Italian Main Dishes

- [Italian Meatball Recipe | Homemade Meatballs](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/italian-meatball-recipe): Classic Italian meatball recipe tutorial with traditional techniques
- [How to make Gnocchi alla Sorrentina like an Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/gnocchi-alla-sorrentina): Ricotta gnocchi with buffalo mozzarella in tomato sauce recipe
- [How to Make MUSHROOM RISOTTO Like an Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/how-to-make-mushroom-risotto): Creamy Italian mushroom risotto recipe without cream
- [How to Make THE PERFECT BEEF TENDERLOIN Like an Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/beef-tenderloin-steak): Italian-style beef tenderloin steak recipe with searing techniques
- [SALMON RECIPE IDEAS | How to Cook Salmon 2 Easy Ways](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/salmon-recipe-ideas): Two easy salmon cooking methods including salmon tarts recipe

## Italian Appetizers & Sides

- [How to Make FRIED MOZZARELLA BALLS Like an Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/fried-mozzarella-balls): Crispy fried mozzarella balls appetizer with breadcrumbs recipe
- [Pecorino Cheese Balls](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/pecorino-cheese-balls): Abruzzo-style pecorino cheese balls fried and simmered in tomato sauce
- [How to Make FARRO SEAFOOD SALAD Like an Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/farro-seafood): Fresh seafood and nutty farro salad Italian recipe
- [How to Make POTATO BAKE Like an Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/potato-bake-recipe): Creamy Italian-style potato bake side dish recipe

## Italian Desserts & Drinks

- [How to Make HOMEMADE LEMON COOKIES Like An Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/italian-lemon-cookies): Tangy Italian lemon biscotti cookies recipe for easy baking
- [How to Make LIMONCELLO COCKTAIL Like an Italian](https://www.vincenzosplate.com/limoncello-cocktail): Italian limoncello cocktail recipe with Frangelico infusion
